title: CRM Pipeline Health Audit: 15 Fields That Kill Sales Velocity
subtitle: Run this audit against your top pipeline stage first. If three items fail, your forecast is already lying to you.

sections.title: Stage Gate Fields
sections.description: The 4 fields that actually move deals through the pipeline.

items.text: Require Exit Criteria Met (Y/N) before any rep can advance a stage.
items.tip: If a rep can drag a deal to Proposal without checking this, the stage means nothing.

items.text: Populate Next Step Date on every open opportunity.
items.tip: Flag anything blank or scheduled more than 14 days out. No date equals no deal.

items.text: Confirm Decision Maker (Y/N) before the Proposal stage.
items.tip: Attended a call does not count. Require explicit rep confirmation in the field.

items.text: Fill Validated Budget Range before pricing goes out.
items.tip: Free-text TBD fails the check. Use a picklist with bands.

sections.title: Data Hygiene Fields
sections.description: The 4 fields that kill forecast accuracy when neglected.

items.text: Refresh email verification status every 7 days, not every 6 weeks.
items.tip: Tools like Prospeo hit 98% verified accuracy on a 7-day cycle versus the 6-week industry average.

items.text: Verify both phone AND email on every primary contact, not one or the other.
items.tip: Single-channel contacts are the number one source of ghost pipeline.

items.text: Auto-enrich firmographic fields (employee count, industry, revenue band) instead of letting reps type them.
items.tip: Rep-typed firmographics fail accuracy checks at 30% or higher.

items.text: Run duplicate detection weekly with auto-merge rules for matches above 95%.
items.tip: Manual dedupe never actually happens. Automate or accept the mess.

sections.title: Governance Fields
sections.description: The 3 fields that stop rep gaming and protect forecast integrity.

items.text: Lock stage history from manual edits across all roles.
items.tip: Reps should never be able to backdate a stage change. Zero exceptions.

items.text: Log every Close Date change with a reason code picklist.
items.tip: If a deal slips three times with no reason code, it is not a deal anymore.

items.text: Trigger manager approval on Amount changes greater than 20%.
items.tip: Silent pricing drops are how forecasts break mid-quarter.

sections.title: Activity Fields
sections.description: The 2 fields that surface real progress instead of vanity engagement.

items.text: Auto-update Last Meaningful Activity only from logged calls, meetings, or replied emails.
items.tip: Opens and clicks do not count. This is the single best stale-deal filter you can build.

items.text: Track Multithreading Count (distinct contacts engaged per deal) at every stage gate.
items.tip: Single-threaded deals past Discovery are a forecast risk flag.

sections.title: Weekly Scorecard
sections.description: The 1 field that keeps reps, managers, and RevOps honest.

items.text: Publish a Field Completeness Score per rep weekly, not monthly.
items.tip: RevOps owns the flag, managers own the conversation. Reps should hear about bad data from their manager, using your scorecard.

items.text: Set a minimum completeness threshold (90%+) tied to pipeline review eligibility.
items.tip: If a rep is below threshold, their deals do not get reviewed in the forecast call.

completion_cta.headline: You finished the audit. Now fix one stage this week.
completion_cta.description: Do not boil the ocean. Pick your top pipeline stage, run these 15 checks against it, and ship the fixes inside 7 days. Then move to the next stage. A clean pipeline is built one gate at a time, not in a quarterly overhaul.
